description: Canonical aidevops registry for underscore-prefixed data planes and cross-plane routing surfaces.

rules: Raw evidence is immutable and authoritative within exactly one corpus.
Transit, case, project, index, normalized, and workflow records are non-authoritative projections or pointers.
Cross-corpus resolution requires an explicit active grant; aliases and physical paths are not authority.
Checkpoints advance only with committed evidence and a current connector lease fence.

_knowledge.purpose: Curated source material, references, extracted facts, and reusable knowledge for AI-assisted retrieval.

versioning_policy.large_blob_policy: Files at or above the blob threshold are stored under ~/.aidevops/.agent-workspace/knowledge-blobs/ with metadata in git.

_knowledge.routing_notes: Use for durable reference material after sensitivity classification and promotion. One corpus-scoped raw evidence object is authoritative; normalized rows and indexes are projections.

_cases.purpose: Audit-trail-driven matter management for legal, compliance, dispute, and operational case work.

versioning_policy.large_blob_policy: Large evidence stays in _knowledge/blob storage and cases attach source pointers rather than duplicating content.

_cases.routing_notes: Use for matter-specific work where chronology, parties, deadlines, or privileged handling matter. Attach validated _knowledge evidence IDs; never copy authoritative evidence.

_inbox.purpose: Transit zone for unclassified captures before sensitivity detection, triage, and routing to durable planes.

versioning_policy.large_blob_policy: Captured binaries remain gitignored until routed or manually promoted.

_inbox.routing_notes: Never treat as authoritative; classify sensitivity before cloud routing. Routing receipts may point to the promoted evidence ID but cannot become evidence.

_campaigns.purpose: Marketing, advertising, outreach, brand assets, campaign creative, and post-launch learnings.
_campaigns.lifecycle_state: concept -> research -> creative -> review -> distribution -> measure -> learn

versioning_policy.large_blob_policy: Campaign assets at or above the blob threshold use the knowledge-blobs store with manifest references.

_campaigns.routing_notes: Use for campaign-shaped work; competitive intel remains local-only.

_projects.purpose: Project artefacts, plans, deliverables, and execution context that are not generic framework TODOs.

versioning_policy.large_blob_policy: Store large binaries in the agent workspace or a project-specific blob store and keep manifests in git.

index_retrieval_surface: agent search over versioned project files
_projects.routing_notes: Use for bounded project execution context when another specialised plane is not a better fit. Evidence links are validated _knowledge pointers plus purpose-specific derived state.

_performance.purpose: Metrics, analytics snapshots, experiment results, and operational performance evidence.

versioning_policy.large_blob_policy: Raw exports stay gitignored or external; derived summaries and reports are versioned.

_performance.routing_notes: Use for measured outcomes, not unverified anecdotes. Raw provider evidence stays private and authoritative in its source; marketing records use pseudonymous subjects and digest references.

_feedback.purpose: User feedback, survey responses, review extracts, pain points, and qualitative signals.

versioning_policy.large_blob_policy: Raw feedback exports remain gitignored; normalized captures and reviewed themes may be versioned only after sensitivity and retention review.

_feedback.routing_notes: Treat raw feedback as potentially personal data until classified. Unverified is an intake state, not a retained sensitivity tier. Commands are optional; direct capture still requires the documented provenance, sensitivity, consent, retention, and promotion gates.
